extend_llama_tokenizer_with_new_tokens: run the script to merge new non-English tokens into the Llama-2 tokenizer model
merge_tokenizer_sentencepieces: merge tokens from a new tokenizer.model into the original Llama-2 tokenizer using sentencepiece protobuf
verify_tokenizer_english_vocab: verify that the extended tokenizer English vocabulary matches the original Llama-2 tokenizer
save_extended_tokenizer: save the merged tokenizer model and pretrained files to a specified output directory
check_token_contains_english: check if a token piece contains English ASCII characters using regex pattern matching
